content:
Hi, 

I don't really know what team(s) I should use.

I'm currently running : Vortice / pontos / castor / horla // Vortice / pontos / sanga / caraboo or mouchette / aigis / helot / ramona.

But do you have other suggestions ? Thanks a lot

Hello there and welcome aboard <:Saya_yum:1513124263291387975> 

Do these teams allow you to achieve your objectives ? If they do, then they're great. If they don't, you'll have to let us know what you feel is lacking.

As for D-tide, my advice : pick 4 awakeners you love, put them each in one team and fill the blank.
The first difficulty should be easy enough to clear with any team ( provided you level them up to 50 ) and you can challenge higher difficulties by borrowing a whale support <:Saya_caught:1513123193341349968>

Thanks !

Well, I'm very early in the game (chapter 2, rank 31) so, any team would allow me to achieve my current objectives I guess. But is the synergy good, or can I optimize them with my current box ?

Hello there <:Saya_yum:1513124263291387975> 

- team 1 & 2 : seem fine to me for a starter.
- team 3 : did you prevent  Lotan:C from activating the alternate chaos realm on purpose ?
- team 4 : poison tends to be rather slow. I would sub Jenkins with Faros ( and Winkle with Celeste ) to maximize your output.
- team 5 : you got Aurita and Corpo. Get your hands on Saya and you'll have a decent discard team, even with Corposant's recent nerf.
Or you could go aequor/ultra with Cassiah.

These teams can get you through the first stage of D-tide. To go further you'll need to tweak them and work and cov and posse but you'll get there as you play <:Saya_caught:1513123193341349968>
adding glotan seems to help patch my weakness by killing them even faster
